name: design-review-gate
description: PreToolUse Bash gate that blocks Stage-4 /ship-feature implementation commands unless the current docs/plans spec has a fresh Gate-A.7 design-review sidecar verdict whose spec_sha256 matches the plan. Missing, stale, RED, UNREACHABLE, and Class-B-applied records BLOCK; GREEN, SKIPPED, and allowed YELLOW records PASS.

input.spec_path: optional docs/plans/<slug>.md path; otherwise inferred from command, feat/* branch, or active marker

blocked_stage4_commands: implement-class commands inside a claimed /ship-feature run
related_invariant: Agentic SDLC / ship-feature Gate-A.7 / design-reasoning review
litmus: Before Stage 4 starts: does docs/plans/<slug>.design-review.json exist, does its spec_sha256 equal the current plan file hash, and is the verdict GREEN, SKIPPED, or an allowed YELLOW with no Class-B adjustment applied to the reviewed spec? If no - BLOCK and rerun Gate-A.7.
origin: XOS-196, 2026-07-03 - enforce Gate-A.7 design-reasoning review as a machine-checked artifact before /ship-feature implementation starts.
